_about: Lab types. Each course picks one in labs/registry.json. A type says what students do and which D2L items each lab has, so a new kind of lab (the Global Passport) can be added without changing the others.

bongo-video.label: Bongo video labs
bongo-video.what: Each lab: an optional mini-quiz, then a 1.5–2 minute Bongo video in the target language, graded on the speaking rubric.
d2l: Each lab: Mini-Quiz (if the course has them), then the Bongo assignment

talkabroad-workshop.label: TalkAbroad conversations with workshops
talkabroad-workshop.what: Each lab: a workshop with a lab assistant, then a 15-minute TalkAbroad conversation with a native speaker.
d2l: Each lab: Workshop dropbox, then TalkAbroad dropbox

global-passport.label: Global Passport
global-passport.what: Planned for the Fall 2027 lab redesign. Its parts get added here when the design is ready.
